/**
 * Build + render script for "__TITLE__". GENERATED by scripts/new-video.ts.
 * Edit the authored scenes below for your topic, then run (THE RELIABLE PATH —
 * do NOT hand-roll the CLI, `tsx -e`, or manual project dirs):
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/build-__ID__.ts stills              # fast layout check (mock voice)
 *   npx tsx --env-file=.env scripts/build-__ID__.ts draft vivibe   # draft for user review
 *   npx tsx --env-file=.env scripts/build-__ID__.ts full  vivibe   # final (after approval)
 *
 * Rules (AGENTS.md + docs/visualization-playbook.md):
 *  - ONE idea per scene; author BESPOKE SVG/CSS for signature beats; vary forms.
 *  - Decompose each sentence for an embedded number / relationship / process.
 *  - Wrap every scene in <Frame><Story ...> so it stays in the content zone.
 *  - Evidence gate: only visualize numbers actually present in your source.
 */
import {
  scaffoldVideoProject, renderProject, admitProjectScenes, loadManifestAsSpec,
  synthesizeNarration, lockSpec, renderSceneStills, generateAuthoredEntry, remotionAppRoot,
} from "../packages/pipeline/src/index.js";
import { projectPaths, writeJson } from "../packages/pipeline/src/store/store.js";
import { writeAuthoredScene } from "../packages/pipeline/src/authoring/manifest.js";

const ID = "__ID__";
const TARGET_SECONDS = 90 as const;

// --- Authored scenes (one module each). Replace these starters with bespoke,
//     topic-specific scenes — see scripts/build-d4rt.ts for worked examples. ---

const STATEMENT = `import React from "react";
import { z } from "zod";
import { registerComponent, type SceneComponentProps } from "@news/compositions";
import { Frame, Story, TitleBlock, Callout } from "@news/blocks";
export const schema = z.object({ meta: z.string().optional(), callout: z.string(), footer: z.string().optional() });
type P = z.infer<typeof schema>;
const Scene: React.FC<SceneComponentProps<P>> = ({ headline, eyebrow, props }) => (
  <Frame><Story eyebrow={eyebrow ?? "TIN"} meta={props.meta} footer={props.footer ? { left: props.footer, right: props.meta } : undefined}>
    <TitleBlock headline={headline} />
    <Callout tone="accent">{props.callout}</Callout>
  </Story></Frame>
);
export const example: P = { callout: "Một ý chính" };
export default registerComponent<P>({ id: "vt-statement", displayName: "Statement", promptGuide: "hook/idea/cta", schema, Component: Scene, example });
`;

const STAT = `import React from "react";
import { z } from "zod";
import { registerComponent, type SceneComponentProps } from "@news/compositions";
import { Frame, Story, CountUp } from "@news/blocks";
export const schema = z.object({ meta: z.string().optional(), to: z.number(), suffix: z.string().optional(), statLabel: z.string(), footer: z.string().optional() });
type P = z.infer<typeof schema>;
const Scene: React.FC<SceneComponentProps<P>> = ({ headline, eyebrow, props }) => (
  <Frame><Story eyebrow={eyebrow ?? "DỮ LIỆU"} meta={props.meta} footer={props.footer ? { left: props.footer, right: props.meta } : undefined}>
    <div style={{ fontFamily: "Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace", fontSize: 34, fontWeight: 800, color: "#6E6757" }}>{headline}</div>
    <CountUp to={props.to} suffix={props.suffix} tone="accent" />
    <div style={{ fontFamily: "Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace", fontSize: 30, color: "#6E6757" }}>{props.statLabel}</div>
  </Story></Frame>
);
export const example: P = { to: 100, suffix: "%", statLabel: "Nhãn" };
export default registerComponent<P>({ id: "vt-stat", displayName: "Stat", promptGuide: "animated number", schema, Component: Scene, example });
`;

type Trans = "slide" | "fade" | "wipe" | "clockWipe" | "zoom";
const M = (id: string, component: string, eyebrow: string, headline: string, narration: string, props: Record<string, unknown>, transitionToNext?: Trans, emphasis?: "zoom") =>
  ({ id, component, eyebrow, headline, narration, props, ...(transitionToNext ? { transitionToNext } : {}), ...(emphasis ? { emphasis } : {}) });

const MANIFEST = {
  title: "__TITLE__",
  theme: { dominant: "#2F6BEF", mood: "editorial" },
  scenes: [
    M("scene-01", "vt-statement", "TIN", "Tiêu đề mở đầu", "Lời dẫn mở đầu — một câu hook trực tiếp.", { meta: "2026", callout: "Ý chính của hook", footer: "CHỦ ĐỀ" }, "slide", "zoom"),
    M("scene-02", "vt-stat", "DỮ LIỆU", "Một con số", "Lời dẫn cho con số quan trọng.", { meta: "2026", to: 100, suffix: "%", statLabel: "Nhãn số liệu", footer: "DỮ LIỆU" }),
  ],
};

const FULL = { safeArea: true, alignment: true, transitions: true, clutter: true, hook: true, cta: true, audio: true, richness: true };

async function setup(): Promise<void> {
  await scaffoldVideoProject({ prompt: MANIFEST.title, projectId: ID, duration: TARGET_SECONDS, tts: { provider: "vivibe" } });
  await writeAuthoredScene(ID, "statement.tsx", STATEMENT);
  await writeAuthoredScene(ID, "stat.tsx", STAT);
  await writeJson(projectPaths(ID).manifest, MANIFEST);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const mode = process.argv[2] ?? "stills";
  await setup();
  const admitted = await admitProjectScenes(ID);
  if (!admitted.ok) { console.error("[vt] admission FAILED", admitted.violations); process.exitCode = 1; return; }
  if (mode === "stills") {
    const spec = await loadManifestAsSpec(ID);
    const tts = await synthesizeNarration(spec, { projectId: ID, provider: "mock" });
    const locked = lockSpec(spec, tts, { mixedNarrationSrc: tts?.mixedSrc });
    const p = projectPaths(ID);
    await writeJson(p.lock, locked);
    const entry = p.authoredDir + "\\_entry.tsx";
    await generateAuthoredEntry({ entryPath: entry, authoredFiles: admitted.files, lockJsonPath: p.lock });
    const out = await renderSceneStills(locked, p.reviewDir, { projectRoot: p.root, entryPoint: entry, remotionRoot: remotionAppRoot() });
    console.log("[vt] stills " + out.length + " frames=" + locked.durationInFrames);
  } else {
    const provider = process.argv[3] === "mock" ? "mock" : "vivibe";
    const quality = mode === "draft" ? "draft" : "full";
    const r = await renderProject(ID, { ttsProvider: provider, checklist: FULL, noCache: true, quality });
    console.log("[vt] " + quality + " mp4=" + r.mp4Path + " (~" + (r.locked.durationInFrames / r.locked.fps).toFixed(1) + "s) ok=" + r.report.ok);
    for (const i of r.report.issues) console.log("  " + i.severity + " " + i.check + " " + (i.sceneId ?? "-") + ": " + i.message);
  }
  console.log("[vt] OK");
}

main().catch((e: unknown) => { console.error("[vt] FAILED"); console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; });
